SierpinskiCarpetTest compile: 'testAsGameOfLife
	| gol |
	gol := (SierpinskiCarpet level: 2) asGameOfLife.
	self assert: gol liveCells size equals: 64.
	self assert: (gol isAliveAt: 0 @ 0).
	self deny: (gol isAliveAt: 4 @ 4)' classified: 'tests'.
SierpinskiCarpetTest compile: 'testLevelOneHasEightCells
	self assert: (SierpinskiCarpet level: 1) cells size equals: 8' classified: 'tests'.
SierpinskiCarpetTest compile: 'testLevelThreeHas512Cells
	self assert: (SierpinskiCarpet level: 3) cells size equals: 512' classified: 'tests'.
SierpinskiCarpetTest compile: 'testLevelTwoHas64Cells
	self assert: (SierpinskiCarpet level: 2) cells size equals: 64' classified: 'tests'.
SierpinskiCarpetTest compile: 'testLevelTwoHolesAreEmpty
	| carpet |
	carpet := SierpinskiCarpet level: 2.
	"the central 3x3 block"
	3 to: 5 do: [ :x | 3 to: 5 do: [ :y |
		self deny: (carpet cells includes: x @ y) ] ].
	"the centre cell of each remaining 3x3 block"
	#(1 4 7) do: [ :x | #(1 4 7) do: [ :y |
		(x = 4 and: [ y = 4 ]) ifFalse: [
			self deny: (carpet cells includes: x @ y) ] ] ]' classified: 'tests'.
DragonCurveTest compile: 'testOrderOneIsASegment
	self assert: (DragonCurve order: 1) points equals: { 0 @ 0. 1 @ 0 } asArray' classified: 'tests'.
DragonCurveTest compile: 'testOrderThreeGolden
	self assert: (DragonCurve order: 3) points
		equals: { 0 @ 0. 1 @ 0. 1 @ 1. 0 @ 1. 0 @ 2 } asArray' classified: 'tests'.
DragonCurveTest compile: 'testPointCounts
	self assert: (DragonCurve order: 8) points size equals: 129.
	self assert: (DragonCurve order: 10) points size equals: 513.' classified: 'tests'.
DragonCurveTest compile: 'testStepsAreUnitSteps
	| pts |
	pts := (DragonCurve order: 10) points.
	1 to: pts size - 1 do: [ :i | | a b |
		a := pts at: i. b := pts at: i + 1.
		self assert: (a x - b x) abs + (a y - b y) abs equals: 1 ]' classified: 'tests'.
TwinDragonTest compile: 'testBothCurvesStartAtOrigin
	| twin |
	twin := TwinDragon order: 8.
	self assert: twin curveOne first equals: 0 @ 0.
	self assert: twin curveTwo first equals: 0 @ 0.' classified: 'tests'.
TwinDragonTest compile: 'testCounts
	self assert: (TwinDragon order: 8) curveOne size equals: 129.
	self assert: (TwinDragon order: 10) curveTwo size equals: 513.' classified: 'tests'.
TwinDragonTest compile: 'testGoldenOrderThree
	| twin |
	twin := TwinDragon order: 3.
	self assert: twin curveOne equals: { 0 @ 0. 1 @ 0. 1 @ 1. 0 @ 1. 0 @ 2 } asArray.
	self assert: twin curveTwo equals: { 0 @ 0. -1 @ 0. -1 @ -1. 0 @ -1. 0 @ -2 } asArray' classified: 'tests'.
TwinDragonTest compile: 'testSecondIsFirstNegated
	| twin one two |
	twin := TwinDragon order: 8.
	one := twin curveOne. two := twin curveTwo.
	1 to: one size do: [ :i |
		self assert: (two at: i)
			equals: ((one at: i) x negated) @ ((one at: i) y negated) ]' classified: 'tests'.
